description.narrative:
The activities narrated here are based on what was submitted in previous communications with Oxfam colleagues back before the launch of the case in Denmark:
The activities will include monitoring and documentation of human rights violations and abusescommitted against the Palestinian people in the Occupied Palestinian territory (OPT; West Bank and Gaza), particularly by Israeli settlers and Israeli Occupying Forces. Based on its documentation, Al-Haq will carry out advocacy activities targeting ThirdStates, and accountability mechanisms such as the ICJ, ICC, the UN and others. Some advocacy activities will be planned and implemented jointly with Oxfam Denmark. Additionally, Al-Haq will look into investigating businesses actively profiting from Israel’s illegal settlements in the OPT, to be used in advocacy to expose the enterprises complicity in war crimes against the Palestinian people.
1. Documenting human rights violations in the Occupied Palestinian Territory (both in the West Bank and Gaza).This includes the primary work carried out by Al-Haq’s field researchers who document human rights violations by all perpetrators, however, under this fund the focus will beon violations by the Israeli Occupying forces, businesses and settlers. This documentation is part of Al-Haq’s work to collect information to be used for its work on advocacy and accountability. 2. Advocacy and accountability communications with Third state and other bodies such as the ICC, and the UN through letters and statements and submissions. Some of these activities are to be carried out jointly with Oxfam Denmark. 3. Advocacy trips/travel to EU and/or other states to raise awareness and advocate for accountability. Destination of the advocacy trips will be decided at a later stage and identified based on the need and advocacy strategies of Al-Haq. 4. Communication activities on social media and similar mediums to raise awareness and highlight trends of violations and litigation carried out by Al-Haq and partners. 5. Focused research/investigation on business activities in Israeli settlements, to be determined based on situation update and a discussion with Oxfam. This activity will be carried out in 2025.
